meta.course: BHMS (Bachelor of Homoeopathic Medicine and Surgery)
meta.source: National Commission for Homoeopathy (NCH) - 'Grading of Homoeopathic Medical Colleges 2024' official document
meta.note_on_2026: No NCH document dated 2026 could be retrieved. This is the most recent official, code-verified list found. No individual college in this list is flagged as a new 2026 approval.
meta.note_on_discrepancy: Secondary consultancy sites (unofficial) claim 50-60 Gujarat BHMS colleges for the 2026 admission cycle - roughly 14-24 more than appear in this official NCH grading list. This likely reflects colleges established after Nov 2024 pending official grading, but that could not be confirmed from a primary source.
meta.short_code_field: The 'short_code' below is the official NCH-assigned College Code from the source document, not an invented abbreviation.
meta.degree_data_caveat: BHMS is confirmed for every entry (this is an NCH BHMS grading list). Postgraduate/MD(Homoeopathy) offerings were NOT verified per college and are marked 'unverified'.
